title: Dreams
mmTitle: အိပ်မက်များ

groups.instructionMy: မဖတ်မီ ဆွေးနွေးရန်

items.prompt: 1. How often do you dream in your sleep?
items.promptMy: အိပ်နေစဉ် မည်မျှမကြာခဏ အိပ်မက်မက်သနည်း။

items.prompt: 2. Recall an unforgettable dream you had, and tell a friend about it.
items.promptMy: မမေ့နိုင်သော အိပ်မက်တစ်ခုကို ပြန်စဉ်းစား၍ သူငယ်ချင်းကို ပြောပြပါ။

items.prompt: 3. What do you dream of becoming?
items.promptMy: အနာဂတ်တွင် မည်သူဖြစ်လာရန် စိတ်ကူးအိပ်မက်ရှိသနည်း။

groups.instruction: A. Complete the following table with what each professional creates. Then, add three more professionals and what they create. The first one is done for you as an example.
groups.instructionMy: ပညာရှင်တစ်ဦးစီ ဖန်တီးသောအရာဖြင့် ဇယားကို ဖြည့်ပါ။ ထို့နောက် အခြားပညာရှင်သုံးဦးနှင့် ၎င်းတို့၏ဖန်တီးမှုများကို ထပ်ဖြည့်ပါ။

items.prompt: 2. a sculptor
3. a novelist
4. a musician
5. a playwright
6. Professional — What they create
7. Professional — What they create
8. Professional — What they create

groups.instruction: B. Match the quotations (1–8) in Column A with their implied meanings (a–h) in Column B.

items.prompt: 1. You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
2. To accomplish great things, we must not only act, but also dream; not only plan, but also believe.
3. We must teach our children to dream with their eyes open.
4. All our dreams can come true if we have the courage to pursue them.
5. Everything starts as somebody’s daydream.
6. When we can’t dream any longer, we die.
7. All men of action are dreamers.
8. If there were dreams to sell, what would you buy?

groups.instruction: C. Give a full-sentence answer to each question below.
groups.instructionMy: အောက်ပါမေးခွန်းတစ်ခုစီကို ဝါကျပြည့်ဖြင့် ဖြေပါ။

items.prompt: 1. According to the passage, when do people dream?
items.promptMy: စာပိုဒ်အရ လူများသည် မည်သည့်အချိန်တွင် အိပ်မက်မက်ကြသနည်း။

items.prompt: 2. How do you feel when you wake up after having a nightmare?
items.promptMy: အိပ်မက်ဆိုးမက်ပြီး နိုးလာသောအခါ မည်သို့ ခံစားရသနည်း။

items.prompt: 3. Do you think that dreams are prophetic? Why or why not?
items.promptMy: အိပ်မက်များသည် အနာဂတ်ကို ကြိုတင်ဟောနိုင်သည်ဟု ထင်သလား။ အဘယ်ကြောင့်နည်း။

items.prompt: 4. What does the underlined word ‘so’ in line 17 refer to?
items.promptMy: စာကြောင်းရေ ၁၇ ရှိ မျဉ်းသားထားသော စကားလုံးသည် မည်သည့်အကြောင်းအရာကို ရည်ညွှန်းသနည်း။

items.prompt: 5. How was the moon regarded by the ancient Greeks and Romans?
items.promptMy: ရှေးခေတ် ဂရိနှင့် ရောမလူမျိုးများက လကို မည်သို့ သတ်မှတ်ခဲ့ကြသနည်း။

items.prompt: 6. According to the author, how does reality begin?
items.promptMy: စာရေးသူအဆိုအရ လက်တွေ့ဖြစ်လာခြင်းသည် မည်သို့ စတင်သနည်း။

items.prompt: 7. What do great inventions and discoveries begin with?
items.promptMy: ကြီးကျယ်သော တီထွင်ဖန်တီးမှုနှင့် ရှာဖွေတွေ့ရှိမှုများသည် မည်သည့်အရာမှ စတင်သနည်း။

items.prompt: 8. How does humankind advance from age to age?
items.promptMy: လူသားမျိုးနွယ်သည် ခေတ်အဆက်ဆက် မည်သို့ တိုးတက်လာသနည်း။

items.prompt: 9. Among the eight quotations, which one do you like most? Why?
items.promptMy: ကိုးကားချက်ရှစ်ခုအနက် မည်သည့်အချက်ကို အနှစ်သက်ဆုံးဖြစ်သနည်း။ အဘယ်ကြောင့်နည်း။

items.prompt: 10. What would you buy if there were dreams to sell?
items.promptMy: အိပ်မက်များကို ရောင်းချလျှင် မည်သည့်အိပ်မက်ကို ဝယ်မည်နည်း။

groups.instruction: A. Choose the correct alternative for each sentence.
groups.instructionMy: ဝါကျတစ်ခုစီအတွက် မှန်ကန်သော စကားလုံးကို ရွေးပါ။

items.prompt: 1. The skin-care product (claims / mentions) that it can prevent moisture loss.
2. Researchers (claimed / proposed) new plans for dealing with climate change.
3. People who are pessimistic have the habit of (describing / pointing out) the weaknesses of others.
4. Many (argue / describe) that music can be used to maintain and promote a better quality of life for older people.
5. The doctor (claimed / said) that the patient should take vitamin supplements.

groups.instruction: B. Rewrite the sentences choosing the correct degree adverbs.
groups.instructionMy: သင့်လျော်သော အတိုင်းအတာပြကြိယာဝိသေသနကို ရွေး၍ ဝါကျများကို ပြန်ရေးပါ။

items.prompt: 1. We (almost / most / scarcely) had time to think and had to act immediately in times of emergency.
2. It’s been (completely / fairly / nearly) three months since we last met.
3. He had been (almost / fairly / nearly) good at drawing when he was at school.
4. You need a / an (completely / extremely / slightly) powerful microscope to see tiny germs.
5. Repairing the computer would cost (almost / largely / pretty) as much as it would to buy a new one.
6. The Dream-K music band is (fairly / largely / nearly) composed of young people.
7. He had (completely / fairly / largely) changed — I didn’t recognize him at all.
8. You need to book (almost / pretty / scarcely) early to get a good seat for the music concert.
9. The food Ni Ni ate this morning made her feel (almost / scarcely / slightly) sick.
10. The train was (completely / nearly / rather) crowded and we were a bit uncomfortable.

groups.instruction: A. Rewrite the following sentences using ‘It is’ / ‘It was’ emphasizing the underlined words as in the example.
groups.instructionMy: ဥပမာအတိုင်း စာအုပ်တွင် မျဉ်းသားထားသောအပိုင်းကို အလေးပေး၍ သတ်မှတ်ပုံစံဖြင့် ဝါကျများကို ပြန်ရေးပါ။

items.prompt: 1. Sleep deprivation affects our overall health and well-being.
2. Darwin attempted to explain the theory of evolution.
3. I began an exercise habit with taking a daily short walk.
4. Nyo Nyo sent a complaint letter to the manager of the supermarket yesterday.
5. The villagers found a huge python in the deep forest.
6. Self-confidence enables us to perform a task well.
7. The number of wildlife has decreased due to the loss of their natural habitats.
8. The kitchen of the school canteen is regularly inspected for cleanliness.
9. A healthy diet creates body resistance to diseases.
10. Regular physical activity is important for losing weight and maintaining good health.

groups.instruction: B. Agree with the following statements using ‘So ... I’ or ‘Neither ... I’ as in the example.
groups.instructionMy: ဥပမာအတိုင်း သတ်မှတ်ထားသော ထောက်ခံသဘောတူပုံစံကို သုံး၍ ပြန်ဖြေပါ။

items.prompt: 1. I didn’t bring my identity card.
2. My friends are passionate about volunteering in charity groups.
3. Many teens aren’t interested in doing house work.
4. I’ll be at the meeting tomorrow.
5. My mother doesn’t like the cold weather.
6. Thuzar can’t play any musical instrument.
7. I’m allergic to seafood.
8. I can’t explain this difficult lesson to you.
9. Nyi Nyi doesn’t think the water is clean.
10. I think the food is very healthy.

groups.instruction: C. Write two sentences for each statement. Begin the second sentence with ‘So’ or ‘Neither’ as in the example.
groups.instructionMy: အဆိုတစ်ခုစီအတွက် ဝါကျနှစ်ကြောင်းရေးပြီး ဒုတိယဝါကျကို ဥပမာပါ သတ်မှတ်စကားလုံးဖြင့် စပါ။

items.prompt: 1. Kind words and good deeds can bring great happiness.
2. My sister and I were not born in Yangon.
3. Nay Chi and Thuzar like collecting coins.
4. Arkar and Sithu haven’t finished their homework yet.
5. Until now, cancer and diabetes are incurable diseases.
6. Zaw Zaw and his friends weren’t sure that they had the time to complete the project.
7. The teacher and his students will never forget the enjoyable excursion.
8. Thailand and Laos are neighbouring countries of Myanmar.
9. Sleep deprivation and over-eating can cause a higher risk of obesity.
10. Su Su and Zin Zin actively participated in the extra-curricular activities of the school.

groups.instruction: A. Listen to a teacher talking about ‘The importance of having big dreams in life’ and complete the statements.
groups.instructionMy: ဘဝတွင် ကြီးမားသောအိပ်မက်ရှိခြင်း၏ အရေးပါမှုအကြောင်း ဆရာတစ်ဦးပြောကြားသည်ကို နားထောင်ပြီး အဆိုများကို ဖြည့်ပါ။

items.prompt: 1. A big dream is ______ or an ambition or something you often think about.
2. According to the teacher, the size of ______ is measured by the size of your dream.
3. A big dream is a vision that both scares and ______ us at the same time.
4. A big dream brings out our passion, imagination, creativity and a ______ to take risks.
5. All of us have ______ that we want to fulfil in life.
6. We must allow ourselves ______ to dream big dreams.
7. Whatever our dream is, we should own it and be ______ it.
8. We must keep working on our plans and implement them ______.
9. According to Walt Disney, all our dreams can come true if we have the ______ to pursue them.
10. Our dream doesn’t happen ______, but, eventually it will happen.

groups.instruction: B. Think of your dream job considering the following points. Then, present it to the class.
groups.instructionMy: စာအုပ်ပါအချက်များကို စဉ်းစား၍ မိမိအိပ်မက်အလုပ်အကိုင်အကြောင်း အတန်းတွင် တင်ပြပါ။

items.prompt: What your dream job is
Why you wish to have that job — any special reasons behind your dream job and who your role model is (if any)
What knowledge and skills you need in order to get your dream job
What you are doing to fulfil your dream

groups.instruction: C. In groups, compare your dream jobs. Which job is the most common and the most unusual in your group? Tell the class about it.
groups.instructionMy: အဖွဲ့လိုက် မိမိတို့၏အိပ်မက်အလုပ်များကို နှိုင်းယှဉ်၍ အများဆုံးရွေးသောအလုပ်နှင့် အထူးခြားဆုံးအလုပ်ကို အတန်းတွင် ပြောပြပါ။

items.prompt: The most common dream job
The most unusual dream job

groups.instructionMy: စာအုပ်ပါ လမ်းညွှန်မေးခွန်းများ

items.prompt: What kind of invention is it?
What is it made of?
Who are the users you have in mind?
How would you name it?
How can it be used?
How much will it cost?
Is it cost-effective (Is it effective without costing a lot of money?)?
What is the prospect (the possibility that it will have in the future) of your invention?

groups.instruction: In groups, think of a dream invention and write a description of it in about 200 words using the following questions.
